🎯 Objective

Design **Freddy AI Agent v1.0** capable of handling **1M queries/day** with scalable, reliable, low-latency architecture.

1\. Architecture Diagram

ASCII Overview  
Frontend (Zendesk) → API Gateway → Async Queue (Kafka)  
                    ↓  
    \[Retrieval Layer\] ←→ \[LLM Layer\] ←→ \[Eval Layer\]  
  (Pinecone \+ PGVector) (RAG \+ Multi-agent) (Day36 Eval Metrics)  
                    ↓  
Monitoring (Prometheus) \+ Self-Healing (Day26 Auto-fixes)

Mermaid Diagram  
![][image1]

A\[Frontend \- Zendesk\] \--\> B\[API Gateway\]  
B \--\> C\[Kafka Queue\]

C \--\> D\[Retrieval Layer \- Pinecone/PGVector\]  
C \--\> E\[LLM Layer \- RAG \+ Multi-agent\]  
C \--\> F\[Eval Layer \- Feedback/ELO\]

D \<--\> E  
E \<--\> F

F \--\> G\[Monitoring \- Prometheus\]  
G \--\> H\[Self-Healing Engine\]

---

2\. Component Deep Dive

A. Kafka Topics:  
   \- support\_tickets  
   \- agent\_handoffs  
   \- eval\_feedback

B. Horizontal Scaling:  
   \- Kubernetes HPA (scale-out when CPU \>70%)

C. Model Routing Strategy:  
   \- Primary: Llama3  
   \- Fallback: GPT-4o (based on Day36 Elo evaluation scores)

D. Caching Layer:  
   \- Redis  
   \- TTL: 5 minutes  
   \- Expected hit rate: 75%

E. Canary Deployment:  
   \- Phase 1: 1% traffic  
   \- Phase 2: 10% traffic  
   \- Phase 3: 50% traffic  
   \- Full rollout after model stability validation
